name: repository-deterministic-baselines
description: Small deterministic research fixtures created for this repository; they are not claimed to be industry-standard datasets.

instances.description: Two face-touching cubes exactly fill the container.
A repeated-dimension box fits using its sole allowed canonical orientation.
Three box types and restricted rotations create a small nontrivial packing case.
Twenty-four optional boxes with candidate volume greater than container volume; intended for time-limited CP-SAT runs.
